question: How do I connect to VPN using Cisco AnyConnect?
ground_truth: Open Cisco AnyConnect, enter vpn.company.com, connect, and authenticate with your corporate username, password, and MFA code.

question: What is the VPN server address?
ground_truth: The VPN server address is vpn.company.com.

question: How do I reset my corporate password?
ground_truth: Go to accounts.company.com/reset, enter your corporate email, click Send Reset Link, and follow the instructions in the email.

question: What are the password requirements?
ground_truth: Passwords must be at least 12 characters with uppercase, lowercase, a number, and a special character. Cannot reuse the last 10 passwords.

question: How do I set up MFA with Microsoft Authenticator?
ground_truth: Install Microsoft Authenticator, go to mfa.company.com, add an authenticator app, scan the QR code, and verify with a test notification.

question: What MFA methods are supported?
ground_truth: Microsoft Authenticator (recommended), Google Authenticator, SMS one-time code (backup only), and hardware token (YubiKey) for admins.

question: How do I install software on my company laptop?
ground_truth: Use Software Center (Windows) or Self Service (macOS) to install pre-approved software. For new software, submit a request at it-portal.internal/software-request.

question: How do I configure Outlook on my phone?
ground_truth: Install Microsoft Outlook from App Store or Google Play, tap Add Account, enter your corporate email, and sign in with your password and MFA.

question: What is the Wi-Fi network for employees?
ground_truth: The corporate Wi-Fi network is CORP-SECURE. Connect with your corporate username and password, with MFA if prompted.

question: How do I give a visitor Wi-Fi access?
ground_truth: Go to wifi-portal.internal/sponsor, enter the guest's name and contact info, select the duration, and click Create. The guest receives an access code.

question: How many vacation days do employees get?
ground_truth: Full-time employees receive 15 days of paid vacation per year for the first 3 years and 20 days from year 4 onwards.

question: What health insurance plans are available?
ground_truth: The company offers Basic HMO, Standard PPO, and Premium PPO plans. Open enrollment is in November.

question: How do I request time off?
ground_truth: Submit a leave request through the HR portal at hr-portal.internal/leave at least 2 weeks in advance for vacations of 3 or more days.

question: Does the company match 401k contributions?
ground_truth: Yes, the company matches 100% of contributions up to 4% of salary, vesting over a 3-year schedule.

question: What is the remote work policy?
ground_truth: The standard hybrid model is 3 days in-office and 2 days remote per week. Employees must be available during core hours 10 AM to 3 PM.

question: When is payday?
ground_truth: Employees are paid bi-weekly on every other Friday.

question: How do I report workplace harassment?
ground_truth: Report incidents to your HR Business Partner, your manager if they are not the offending party, or anonymously via the ethics hotline.

question: What is the parental leave policy?
ground_truth: Primary caregivers receive 16 weeks of paid parental leave. Secondary caregivers receive 4 weeks.

question: Does the company offer a home office stipend?
ground_truth: New remote employees receive a one-time $500 home office setup stipend, submitted within 60 days.

question: How do I access my pay stubs?
ground_truth: Pay stubs are available in the HR portal under Payroll then Pay History.

question: What happens after five incorrect password attempts?
ground_truth: The account is locked after five incorrect attempts. Wait 15 minutes for the lock to clear automatically, or use the self-service reset page.

question: How long is a password reset link valid?
ground_truth: A password reset link is valid for 30 minutes.

question: What should I do if AnyConnect shows an untrusted-server certificate error?
ground_truth: Do not proceed on a company network and contact IT immediately. On a home network, restart the router because it may be a DNS problem.

question: Which Ubuntu versions support the company VPN?
ground_truth: The supported Linux versions are Ubuntu 20.04 LTS and Ubuntu 22.04 LTS.

question: What should I do if Software Center shows no applications?
ground_truth: Connect to the corporate network or VPN, restart the Intune or Jamf management agent, and contact IT if the problem continues.

question: How long does IT Security take to review a new software request?
ground_truth: IT Security reviews software requests within three business days.

question: How long is a guest Wi-Fi session passcode valid?
ground_truth: A guest passcode is valid for eight hours, or one day for contractors.

question: What can I do when MFA push notifications are not arriving?
ground_truth: Enable notification permissions, check Do Not Disturb settings, or use the TOTP code shown in the authenticator app.

question: Can I install a torrent client on my company laptop?
ground_truth: No. Torrenting clients such as BitTorrent and uTorrent are prohibited software.

question: What applications need attention after I reset my password?
ground_truth: Update saved browser passwords and re-authenticate mobile applications and Cisco AnyConnect. All active sessions are signed out.
